source_snapshot.items: Persistent UCE on Full-Mirror primary channel
source_snapshot.procedure: Use verified mirror map and masks0x3; inject persistent UCE at0x100000000 with oneInjection=False; inspect B2CMI and pre-go failover; go; verify primary ddr4chnlfailed=1 and secondary buddychnlfailed=1.
source_snapshot.criteria: Persistent injection and failover logs match.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL generic logs omit persistent mode and state transition.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Restores persistent semantics, B2CMI pre/post evidence and controlled recovery.

old_problem: Persistent injector semantics, primary/secondary B2CMI mapping, exact pre/post failover bits and degraded-channel recovery are not safely inferable.
disposition_reason: ED-16 requires approved injection and Recovery. `oneInjection=False` can repeatedly fault the line; PASS depends on a bounded persistent event and exact transition from pre-go healthy state to primary ddr4chnlfailed and secondary buddychnlfailed after go, with a plan to remove the injector and recover degraded memory.
decision_basis: Preserved mirror-map dependency, masks0x3, persistent UCE, B2CMI pre-go state, go and both post-go failover bits.
Distinguished persistent failover from row165 one-shot UCE correction.
No injector, go, boot or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: GNR Full-Mirror persistent primary UCE channel failover
test_case.purpose: Prove a bounded persistent primary UCE drives the mapped Full-Mirror pair into the specified controlled channel-failover state.
required_package: Exact masks and B2CMI pre/post failover decoder
Dedicated SUT, serial/OOB and settings rollback
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator verifies mirror/map baseline, applies masks0x3, arms one bounded persistent UCE at0x100000000, captures B2CMI status and pre-go ddr4chnlfailed=0, executes go once, captures primary ddr4chnlfailed=1 and secondary buddychnlfailed=1, disarms injector per approved procedure, verifies degraded state/health and restores configuration.
test_case.expected_result: The intended mirror pair alone transitions from clean pre-go state to the approved primary/secondary failover bits, without uncontrolled repeated faults; injector is removed and recovery/restoration succeeds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target/masks, bounded persistent semantics, correct B2CMI pre/post transition, no wrong-pair/fatal escape, proven disarm and final recovery. Missing transition, uncontrolled injection, hang or recovery failure fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Critical persistent-injection authorization on isolated SUT.
Approve bounded trigger and deterministic injector-disarm before arming.
Continuous serial/OOB capture; stop on wrong pair or fatal escalation.
expected_evidence: Injector disarm, degraded health, recovery/restoration verdict
test_case.recovery: On uncontrolled repetition, wrong pair or hang, preserve evidence and use approved OOB recovery; disarm injector through the vendor path before any reboot, then restore mirror/debug settings and validate memory topology.
